notes.title: Graphics and more performance optimization for low end devices
notes.content:
What's New:
-Graphics improvements and optimized for low end graphics cards.
-Performance improved even more at the highest settings.

notes.title: Hatch bug Fixed
notes.content:
What's new:
-The Hatch Glitch when the player head to the cave is fixed now!
-Minor physics bugs fixed.

notes.title: Lighting Optimized
notes.content: Fix some lighting and fog details.

notes.title: Hunted Within: The Walls — Now Available

Can you survive long enough to uncover what lies beyond the walls?[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3439440/Hunted_Within_The_Walls/"]Play Hunted Within: The Walls on Steam[/url].[/p]
